items.title: 5U AI scales up new digital workforce platform - American Journal of Transportation
items.summary: “We are not building another chatbot that answers questions and disappears, we are building AI Workers that understand freight operations, carry out the work, and capture the reasoning behind every decision, so teams can scale their knowledge as well as their capacity.”. 5U AI works inside existing freight systems and uses multi-agent AI trained for logistics workflows, including the complex exceptions and manual decisions that make forwarding operations difficult to automate with generic AI tools or legacy automation. The company is already live with forwarders and carriers across Europe, including with TCI International Logistics, where its AI Workers are being used across air and ocean freight operations. 5U AI is growing its team as part of the scale-up, with plans to hire across product, engineering, operations, commercial, and customer functions. “AI is one of the most exciting developments logistics has seen for a generation, but its value will depend on people who understand the industry and want to build practical tools that solve real operational problems,” said Abik.

At least that’s what David Weston, corporate VP for AI security at Microsoft told his audience during a Microsoft Security launch preview on July 27. During the event, the Redmond-based company announced a flurry of new AI and security products and initiatives. First, Microsoft launched Project Perception, a new agentic security system designed to help cyber defenders continuously identify, evaluate and reduce security risk. The tech firm also announced the launch of the Microsoft Security Frontier Offensive Research and Generative Exploration (FORGE) Lab. The lab will be led by Team Atlanta,, the group of cybersecurity researchers that won the US Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency’s (DARPA) AI Cyber Challenge (AIxCC) at DEFCON in the summer 2025, after Microsoft hired the team to head the new initiative, Gallot said.

items.title: AI for News - AI Tool For News
items.summary:
## Overview

AI for News is a sophisticated tool designed to generate news content based on specific keywords. It is intuitive and allows users to input custom search parameters such as the period for the news search and preferred news sources, which include Google News, YouTube, and Reddit. [...] AI for News is highly efficient compared to traditional news aggregation systems. It leverages advanced language processing models to generate precise and targeted news contents based on user-defined parameters in a very short amount of time.

Can I select the output language in AI for News?

Yes, users can select their preferred output language in AI for News. This feature allows users to receive news content in a language they are most comfortable with, enhancing the tool's usability. [...] Yes, AI for News uses natural language processing for news content generation. This AI capability enables it to understand, analyze, and transform raw data into readable news articles.

How can I use AI for News to track news from specific periods?

Users can use AI for News to track news from specific periods by specifying the news search period in the custom search parameters. Options include the last three days, the last seven days, or the last 30 days.

Unlike autonomous driving or industrial robotics, healthcare robotics can’t rely on internet-scale data collection or unlimited real-world experimentation. Every demonstration requires specialized equipment, clinical expertise, and access to patients or laboratory environments. This creates three fundamental challenges for developers.
